tactics:
cases h with
  | inl hp => exact Or.inr hp
  | inr hq => exact Or.inl hq

cases h with
  | inl hp => exact hp
  | inr hp => exact hp

cases h with
  | inl hx => exact hp hx
  | inr hx => exact hq hx

cases h with
  | intro hp hq => exact ⟨hq, hp⟩
exact fun ha hb => h ⟨ha, hb⟩

intro ha hb
  exact h ⟨ha, hb⟩

rcases h with hp | hp
  exact hp
  exact hp

rcases h with hp | hq
  exact Or.inr hp
  exact Or.inl hq

rcases h with hx | hx
  exact hp hx
  exact hq hx

rcases h with ⟨hp, hq⟩
  exact ⟨hq, hp⟩
